fields.name: Elden Ring
fields.summary: An action RPG developed by FromSoftware set in a vast open world filled with challenging enemies and rich lore co-created with George R.R. Martin.
fields.notes: Won Game of the Year 2022. Notoriously difficult but rewarding.

fields.name: Minecraft
fields.summary: A sandbox survival and creative game where players explore procedurally generated worlds, gather resources, and build structures. One of the best-selling games of all time.
fields.notes: Great for all ages. Java Edition recommended for mods.

fields.name: The Shawshank Redemption
fields.summary: A 1994 drama film directed by Frank Darabont. Andy Dufresne, a banker wrongly convicted of murder, forms a friendship with fellow prisoner Red while enduring life in Shawshank prison.
fields.notes: Rated #1 on IMDb. A must-watch classic.

fields.name: Interstellar
fields.summary: A 2014 sci-fi epic directed by Christopher Nolan. A team of astronauts travels through a wormhole near Saturn in search of a new home for humanity.
fields.notes: Hans Zimmer's score is incredible. Best watched in IMAX.

fields.name: Breaking Bad
fields.summary: A chemistry teacher diagnosed with terminal cancer teams up with a former student to manufacture and sell methamphetamine to secure his family's future. Widely considered one of the greatest TV shows ever made.
fields.notes: Watch it all the way through, it just gets better. Do not skip.

fields.name: God of War
fields.summary: Kratos and his son Atreus journey through the Norse realms in this action-adventure game by Santa Monica Studio. A masterpiece of storytelling and combat.
fields.notes: One of PlayStation's best exclusives. The sequel Ragnarok is also incredible.

fields.name: The Last of Us
fields.summary: A post-apocalyptic action-adventure game by Naughty Dog. Joel smuggles 14-year-old Ellie across a ravaged United States. Now also a critically acclaimed HBO series.
fields.notes: One of the best stories ever told in a video game.

fields.name: The Dark Knight
fields.summary: Christopher Nolan's 2008 superhero film in which Batman faces the Joker, a criminal mastermind who seeks to create chaos in Gotham City. Heath Ledger's performance is legendary.
fields.notes: Heath Ledger won a posthumous Oscar for his Joker. Still holds up perfectly.

fields.name: Inception
fields.summary: A 2010 sci-fi thriller by Christopher Nolan. Dom Cobb specializes in entering people's dreams to steal secrets, but is offered a chance to have his record erased if he can plant an idea instead.
fields.notes: The ending is still debated. Watch it twice.

fields.name: Stranger Things
fields.summary: A Netflix sci-fi horror series set in the 1980s following a group of kids in Hawkins, Indiana who encounter supernatural forces and government conspiracies.
fields.notes: Season 1 and 4 are the best. Great 80s nostalgia and soundtrack.
